mechanism.notes: spherical Watt six-bar: 3R (J1 O20, J2/J3 O15 slim, MR117-2RS pairs) with link 2 split at a passive knee K and a rocker C from link 1 (pin P) to L2b (pin Q); P/K/Q MR63ZZ pairs in O10 bosses; bodies link 1 (+P plate), L2a, L2b (+Q tail), rocker, arm-end (hub-3 plate + K7 neck); custom: base, link 1, L2a, L2b, rocker, arm-end neck, 3 hub shafts, 3 pin shafts; catalogue: 3 MR117 pairs + 3 MR63ZZ pairs. The four-pin spherical loop is overconstrained in space (axis concurrency).
